test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. It is also called a nuclear family.

B. It is good to be in a small family because there is better management of resources.

C. A small family is one with parents and a maximum of two children.

D. The advantages of a small family are numerous.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To form a coherent paragraph, we need to arrange the sentences logically to provide a clear flow of information.
 
• **Sentence C is the first sentence** as it defines what a small family is:
 
 
• "A small family is one with parents and a maximum of two children."
 
 
 
• **Sentence A follows** as it gives another name for a small family:
 
 
• "It is also called a nuclear family."
 
 
 
• **Sentence D is the third sentence** because it highlights the advantages mentioned in the subsequent sentence:
 
 
• "The advantages of a small family are numerous."
 
 
 
• **Sentence B is the fourth** as it elaborates on a specific advantage of a small family:
 
 
• "It is good to be in a small family because there is better management of resources."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **CADB**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"A small family is one with parents and a maximum of two children. It is also called a nuclear family. The advantages of a small family are numerous. It is good to be in a small family because there is better management of resources."
